scientific_integrity: Analytic proof is distinct from finite verifier; the standard identity, carry bound, and sufficient converse are attributed to Holt (2014). No external certification asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact for reverse multiples without leading zeros; does not classify shifted-symmetric or asymmetric palintiples. Equivalent publication elsewhere has not been excluded, and there is no independent proof audit.
title: The carry divisibility conjecture for symmetric palintiples
